text: August 2, 2002 - Structural characteristics of Kate music include triadic and pentatonic melody, both pure and in various degrees of blending; monophony (music having a single voice part); reverting and progressive strophes (stanzas) of varying lengths; basically isorhythmic organization (i.e., using recurring rhythmic patterns); and a wide range of tempi.
